sloka: क्वासि यन्ता महाकाय क्षुधिताया ममेप्सितः ।भक्षः प्रीणय मे देहं चिरमाहारवर्जितम् ।। ५.५८.३९ ।।।।
transliteration: kvāsi yantā mahākāya kṣudhitāyā mamepsitaḥ ।bhakṣaḥ prīṇaya me dehaṁ ciramāhāravarjitam ।। 5.58.39 ।।।।

translations.english: 'O huge monkey where are you going? I am hungry since long. I am going without food and must eat you. Make me satisfied'.
